modifications: None. Original official GMT bytes retained.
upstream_processing: MSigDB subset of Reactome 95, with upstream redundancy filtering by Jaccard similarity and pathway hierarchy; not the entire live Reactome database.
selection_rationale: Preselected broader curated pathway collection before gene coverage or explanation scores were calculated; preserve Hallmark as comparator.

attribution: MSigDB: Broad Institute, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and Regents of the University of California. Original pathway knowledge: Reactome.
